svg.title: NeuroSciFi system architecture
svg.desc: NeuroSciFi runs on one NVIDIA DGX Spark. Clients on the left: the Pocket PWA on phones and tablets (HTTPS through a local CA, pairing families, signed node keys, opt-in Web Push), the owner's console on loopback with a session token, the nsf command line and MCP, and voice through the microphone and speaker of the console or Pocket. On the Spark, the Pocket bridge, console server, nsf process, opt-in autonomy and the Voice Cortex bridge all submit to one orchestrator (privacy screen, web switch, budgets), so a typed, spoken or Pocket question takes the same path. Web Cortex, off by default, runs intent, discovery, safe fetch with robots.txt and an honest User-Agent, extraction, claims, verification with six states, synthesis, word sense with other senses set aside, and consolidation. Only verified evidence goes to the inference gateway, whose local vLLM model writes the answer and whose evidence guard checks every sentence; the cited report goes back to the console, voice or Pocket, and an empty Web Push can wake Pocket. Verified claims become knowledge candidates, hypotheses and predictions, and enter the individual only when the owner accepts them. The individual is one SQLite file on the LUKS2-encrypted disk: beliefs, evidence, epochs, graphs, knowledge, transcripts and checkpoints. A resource scheduler and the Presence Cortex sit beside it. Loopback-only local services: vLLM on port 8811, Whisper ASR on 18431, Kokoro TTS on 18432 and SearXNG on 8888 in Docker, plus a sandboxed Chromium for bounded news rendering. Only screened queries, page fetches and empty pushes leave the host, to the public web, structured APIs (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, PyPI, npm, OSV, GitHub, Wikipedia), the optional keyed Brave Search API and the browser push services.

g.text: One individual in one SQLite file is the single authority. A typed, spoken or Pocket question takes the same path.
v0.7.0 · reference host: NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10
LUKS2 disk: the individual, checkpoints, weights, Docker data
ORCHESTRATOR · privacy screen · web switch · budgets
one SQLite file · the single authority
